description: This file defines a Spring-managed service class that handles delete commands for client charges within the Fineract system. It implements a specific handler interface and uses dependency injection to perform charge deletion via the service layer.

classes.name: DeleteClientChargeCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles deletion of client charges by processing commands and delegating to the write platform service.

methods.name: DeleteClientChargeCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the write platform service dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command and triggers deletion of the charge for the specified client.
